---
name: Accessibility Barrier / Data Update
about: Report a physical barrier or update audited infrastructure data
title: "[BARRIER] "
labels: data-audit, barrier
assignees: ''
---

**Precinct / Location**
- Precinct Name: [e.g. AIIMS Metro & Hospital Precinct]
- Specific Location / Landmark: [e.g. Near OPD Gate 2]
- GPS Coordinates (if known): [e.g. 28.5672, 77.2104]

**Barrier Type**
- [ ] Broken or missing dropped kerb
- [ ] Steep slope / ramp (> 1:12)
- [ ] Steps or stairs without ramp
- [ ] Footpath obstruction / illegal parking
- [ ] Construction blockage
- [ ] Missing tactile paving
- [ ] Inaccessible doorway / entrance

**Severity**
- [ ] Passable with caution
- [ ] Restricted (difficult for manual wheelchairs)
- [ ] Blocked (strictly impassable for wheelchair/pram users)

**Description & Evidence**
Detailed description of the barrier and observed dimensions (e.g. width, step height). Attach photos if available.
